newsitem.title: FINLAND: KEMIRA'S TIKKURILA IN NEW JOINT VENTURE.
newsitem.headline: KEMIRA'S TIKKURILA IN NEW JOINT VENTURE.

text.p: Tikkurila Oy, part of chemicals and fertiliser group Kemira Oy, said in a statement on Tuesday it would start a European binding agent joint venture with Swedish AB Wilh.Becker and US McWhorter Technologies .
"The new company, McWhorter Technologies Europe, will supply binding agents to the European paint industry," it said.
The joint venture -- to be based in Molndal in Sweden -- will have a capacity of 50,000 tonnes, annual sales of 260 million markka and 140 employees, Tikkurila said.

The joint venture consist of Tikkurila's binding agent unit in Vantaa, Finland, Soab AB's factory in Molndal, Sweden, Kemira Coatings Ltd's factory in Bury, Great Britain, and the headquarters in Molndal, it said.
